game: Wizardry Variants Daphne (Steam), 1920x1080, live chest in a corridor
note: ONE CHEST, captured live to settle what the chest flow actually does. Two sequences: an untrapped opening (open-*.jpg) and a trapped disarm (qte-*.jpg, qte-bar-*.jpg).
flow: approach the chest: a two-line menu 打开 / 什么也不做 appears
打开 -> the 由谁打开? panel (see ../2026-10-24-opener/)
pick a member -> the chest opens; if it is NOT trapped the lid animation and the hand play with no bar (open-*.jpg)
if it IS trapped the disarm bar appears at the top with a red time bar under it (qte-*.jpg, qte-bar-*.jpg)
